You may find the information you need in the FAQs about the MXR DISTORTION III M115 listed below. How do I power the MXR Distortion III? You can power the MXR Distortion III using one 9-volt battery, a 9-volt AC adapter such as the Dunlop ECB003/ECB003E, or a DC Brick power supply. To use a battery, remove the bottom plate to install it. 0 What should I do if there is no sound when using my MXR Distortion III? First, ensure the pedal is powered correctly and that the cables are connected properly. Make sure to run a cable from your guitar to the Distortion III's INPUT jack, and another from the OUTPUT jack to your amplifier. 0 How can I adjust the sound of my MXR Distortion III? You can adjust the sound by using the three controls: DISTORTION, TONE, and OUTPUT. Rotate the DISTORTION knob to change the amount of distortion, the TONE knob for a brighter or darker sound, and the OUTPUT knob to adjust the effect volume. 0 Why is the LED indicator not turning on? If the LED indicator does not turn on, check whether the pedal is properly powered and that the footswitch is engaged to toggle the effect on. 0 What should I do if the distortion sounds too harsh? Try adjusting the TONE knob to find a sound that is less harsh. Turning the knob counterclockwise will give a darker sound, which may help in achieving the desired tone. 0 Is the manual of the MXR DISTORTION III M115 available in English? sources.excerpt: Dunlop MXR Distortion III M115 User Manual PDF | Manualsnet --> Dunlop Pedal MXR Manuals Dunlop MXR Distortion III M115 Instruction Manual Pages 2 Year 0 Language(s) en Share PDF Preview Text Only Previous  of 2   GO Next Previous  of 2   GO Next Page 1 92503005351revC M115 DISTORTION III Page 2 SAMPLE SETTINGS M115 DISTORTION III SMOOTH OVERDRIVE SINGING SUSTAINCRUNCHY RHYTHM DUNLOP MANUFACTURING, INC. P.O. BOX 846 BENICIA, CA 94510 U.S.A. TEL: 1-707-745-2722 FAX: 1-707-745-2658 POWER The MXR Distortion III is powered by one 9-volt battery (remove bottom plate to install), a 9-volt AC adapter such as the Dunlop ECB003/ECB003E, or a DC Brick power supply. DESCRIPTION Dynamic, touch-sensitive response Proprietary circuit design delivers rich harmonics Large output range True bypass DIRECTIONS Run a cable from your guitar to the Distortion IIIs INPUT jack and run another cable from the Distortion IIIs OUTPUT jack to your amplifier. Start with all controls at 12 oclock. Turn the effect on by depressing the footswitch. Rotate the DISTORTION knob clockwise to increase amount of distortion or counterclockwise to decrease it. Rotate the TONE knob clockwise for a brighter sound or counterclockwise for a darker sound. Rotate the OUTPUT knob clockwise to increase overall effect volume or counterclockwise to decrease it.
